description: Bagging ensemble of decision trees. Each tree trains on a bootstrap sample with a random feature subset; predictions are majority-voted. Reduces variance compared to a single tree.
why_tested: End-semester addition; tests whether bagging stabilizes tree predictions and improves over a single decision tree.
input_features: Dense TruncatedSVD (100 components, training-fold fitted) of word unigram/bigram TF-IDF.
selection_rule: Max mean macro F1 on fixed group-respecting CV folds (development data only)
artifact_note: Fitted development pipeline saved to models/random_forest/artifacts/{protocol}/ (model.joblib + svd.joblib + metadata.json).
